scheme_name: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Water Augmentation
other_conditions: The applicant must not have received a subsidy for Water Augmentation during the XII plan period.
Land records must be in the beneficiary's name and certified by the Village Authority, State Government, or Competent Authority.
Water augmentation structures must be located on the estate or within its vicinity.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 75% of the unit cost for water storage tanks and irrigation equipment, capped at ₹1,25,000 for all related activities combined.
documents_required: Land records certified by Village Authority/State Government/Competent Authority
